messages:
Maya (PM): dropped a new compact-capacity card mock — includes inline min/max steppers, pool selector, and a collapsed 'Burst settings' row. figma: https://figma.com/file/def456. Can we do quick UX + a11y pass? :eyes:
Evan (Design): Looks tight and scan-friendly. Question: label for burst — keep 'Burst' or 'Temporary burst'? space is tight. Also the price delta is shown as '-28%' in green next to pool name.
Tess (Eng): Technical note: showing delta inline is easy. We'll need to localize percent formatting. For the collapsed burst, avoid remounting the slider; toggling visibility keeps state.
Ivy (A11y): Important: accordion must follow ARIA pattern. Use aria-expanded on the toggle and role=region on the content, with tabindex=-1 and panel.focus() after expand to provide context without scrolling. Also don't rely on color to indicate 'cheaper' — add a chevron-down icon or text 'cheaper'.
Maya (PM): Good — on color we can add a small down-arrow icon plus the percent. Evan, can you try muted microcopy under the pool name for delta instead of inline to reduce noise?
Evan (Design): Yes. Microcopy under name looks cleaner. For burst label I'd prefer 'Burst capacity' if space allows, otherwise 'Burst'. Tooltip: 'temporary GPUs for peak traffic; may be preempted; billed per-minute'.
Tess (Eng): For keyboard flow I propose: Tab -> pool selector -> min stepper -> max stepper -> burst toggle (Space/Enter) -> if expanded focus slider -> Escape collapses and returns to burst toggle. We'll add unit tests to assert this behavior.
Ivy (A11y): Also add an aria-live='polite' region for state messages like 'Burst enabled' so SR users get updates. Make sure focus outlines don't overlap adjacent elements — expand hit targets or inset the outline.
ci-bot: test run queued: adding accessibility assertions for aria-expanded and role=region.
Maya (PM): Thanks team. Evan I'll update the figma to show microcopy under pool name and an info icon for the tooltip. Tess/Ivy, can you collaborate on the PR to keep the slider mounted and add ARIA roles? I'll review once it's up. :sparkles:
